scientific_integrity: Analytic all-time proof supplied, with exact rational and numerical checks distinguished from proofs. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive Gaussian noise, positive strict payoff gaps, interior initial resource, positive initial frequency of high-on-replete/low-on-depleted phenotype; no mutation, stochastic finite population, or other population faces. General dominated strategy elimination and equilibrium phase diagram are credited as prior work.
title: Uniform phenotypic fixation and critical inverse-time resource laws in a Bayesian eco-evolutionary game
